topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Master William, neighbor and friend, comes to me with a proposal most strange. He speaks of putting up a fence 'twixt our plots, a sturdy line of wood where once there was only the good earth and the crops we've shared. My hands tremble as I turn the soil, thinking of the days when we've lent each other a hand, a seed, and sometimes even a bit of coin. This fence speaks of hard times and closed hearts, a barrier as much in spirit as in form. The saints, be they merciful, let it not be so. For in this narrow valley, the land and its people are all we have, and tearing that fabric seems a curse we cannot afford. I pray that Master William sees the wisdom of open fields and open hearts.
